3.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
3.text: "I just received official confirmation that our neighbor has been accepted into the Arcasian Treaty Organization."

8.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
8.text: "Precisely. Prime Minister Alvarez will make the official announcement tomorrow."

9.speaker: Lucita Azaro
9.text: "Didn't we all see this coming? It should hardly be a surprise."

10.speaker: Lucita Azaro
10.text: "Are you trying to be humorous, Your Majesty?"

11.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
11.text: "I'm sure that was a joke. He knows it could only have been Lespia."

12.speaker: Hugo Toras
12.text: "Thank you for updating us, Mr. Esquibel. I suggest we set a date for a meeting to discuss Lespia's ATO membership as well as our general foreign policy strategy."

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: I had barely even started my reign, and it already felt like the ground was shifting beneath my feet.

14.speaker: Narrator
14.text: What other challenges lay in store?

15.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
15.text: "Indeed, this development has been on the horizon for some time. But our relations with our neighbors are sure to change because of it."

16.speaker: Narrator
16.text: On the way back from the Plavo Archsanctuary, I met my council in the city of Folce Dator for a briefing on our security and military situation.

17.speaker: Narrator
17.text: The so-called "Forge of Rizia" was famous for its numerous foundries and factories, in which iron from the nearby hills was transformed into rifles and handguns.

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: Largest of them all was the Royal Folce Foundry, responsible for supplying the Rizian police and military. The red brick complex towered at the end of the King's Avenue, Folce Dator's main road.

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: My council and I were given a tour of the facilities before settling around the table in the foundry's Great Hall. Murals on the walls around us depicted the city's history as an industrial center.

20.speaker: Narrator
20.text: As duchess of the province and my war and security councilor, Lucita sat at the head of the table. She nodded at the rest of us.

21.speaker: Lucita Azaro
21.text: "Your Majesty, Your Highness, my esteemed fellow councilors."

26.speaker: Lucita Azaro
26.text: "I planned this meeting here so that the King would have a shorter journey after his consecration ceremony."

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: A corner of her mouth twisted upwards.

28.speaker: Lucita Azaro
28.text: "Serendipitously, His Majesty's wise rejection of the ceremony has left us with more time to spend in this fine city."

29.speaker: Lucita Azaro
29.text: "I'm sure the proceedings were very taxing, Your Majesty. Whatever they were."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "What happened in Plavo is between me and God."

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "You're wrong, Duchess Azaro. I have never felt so invigorated."

32.speaker: Player_Romus
32.text: "It was taxing, for sure. But it was my duty as King to bear that burden."

33.speaker: Lucita Azaro
33.text: "Let's hope that something useful came out of all that."

34.speaker: Lucita Azaro
34.text: "I'm glad to hear it. Religion has that effect on some people, I'm told."

36.speaker: Narrator
36.text: Sal was sitting across from me, still wearing his robes. He smiled enigmatically.

37.speaker: Sal Ignacius
37.text: "I am but a lowly conduit between His Majesty and the powers above, Ms. Azaro."

38.speaker: Sal Ignacius
38.text: "Even if you are not a believer, Ms. Azaro, I assure you the six stars of St. Wruhec shine upon your house and our troops."

39.speaker: Narrator
39.text: Sal was sitting across from me, still wearing his robes. He smiled enigmatically.

40.speaker: Narrator
40.text: Sal was sitting across from me, still wearing his robes. He smiled enigmatically.

41.speaker: Sal Ignacius
41.text: "Religion is not a tool to be used, Ms. Azaro. It is a guiding light that shines even on those who do not believe in it."

43.speaker: Hugo Toras
43.text: "I know better than to pry into the contents of the ceremony, Your Majesty. But I will say I hope it was an enlightening experience."

44.speaker: Hugo Toras
44.text: "You may proceed with your briefing, Duchess Azaro."

46.speaker: Narrator
46.text: She gestured at one of the murals on the wall. It depicted a beautiful but severe-looking woman riding a horse down the King's Avenue, her rifle at the ready.

47.speaker: Lucita Azaro
47.text: "My ancestress Ana Azaro ordered the construction of this foundry in 1812, immediately after the end of the War of Rizian Succession."

48.speaker: Lucita Azaro
48.text: "House Azaro knows that 'peacetime' is not a period of rest. It is a time to gather our strength and hone our weapons for when they are next needed."

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "That's a rather pessimistic view, Duchess Azaro. Isn't peace the final state that all nations strive towards?"

51.speaker: Player_Romus
51.text: "I agree with you completely, Duchess. Rizia has become soft and complacent during these conflict-free years."

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "We can also use peacetime to form new alliances and improve international relations. Strength is about more than just weaponry."

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "Yes, we should remain vigilant and prepared. But not to the point where our military focus detracts from the needs of the Rizian people."

55.speaker: Lucita Azaro
55.text: "Alliances can shift. Treaties can be broken. We should not be so naive as to assume every nation will respect diplomatic boundaries."

56.speaker: Lucita Azaro
56.text: "Safety is at the top of the hierarchy of our people's needs, is it not? Everything else is optional."

57.speaker: Lucita Azaro
57.text: "Ideally, maybe. But reality has taught us that peace is fragile. We can only preserve it with hard work and a firm hand."

59.speaker: Lucita Azaro
59.text: "Our failure to win the Reclamation War and the rebellion of 1926 served as a double blow to the Rizian armed forces."

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: I could hear the passion rising in her voice.

61.speaker: Lucita Azaro
61.text: "Even after my father purged the troops and general staff of all suspected traitors to the throne, His Majesty King Valero was reluctant to restore our military to its former strength."

62.speaker: Lucita Azaro
62.text: "As a result, Your Majesty, we are ludicrously underprepared for a country of our size."
62.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Focus_ArmedForces"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Overflowing"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_High"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_Massive"] == true)) == false)

63.speaker: Narrator
63.text: With lightning speed, she reached under the table, pulled out a knife and hurled it in the direction of the doorway. Titus languidly snatched it out of the air.

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: "I have a few more questions regarding the military."

65.speaker: Lucita Azaro
65.text: "I'm here to answer them, Your Majesty. Where should I start?"

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "What's the state of our military production industry?"
66.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_Weapons"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_Conscription"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_NavyAir"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_Weapons"] == true) == false)

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "Tell me more about our naval and air capabilities."
67.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_NavyAir"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_Conscription"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_NavyAir"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_Weapons"] == true) == false)

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "Let's talk about army conscription. How do we bolster our ranks?"
68.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_Conscription"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_Conscription"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_NavyAir"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_Weapons"] == true) == false)

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "Does our internal security need improvement as well?"

71.speaker: Lucita Azaro
71.text: "Despite our very grand surroundings, we have long neglected the potential of Folce Dator."

72.speaker: Lucita Azaro
72.text: "Rumburg currently supplies us with the bulk of our weaponry, including their KA-74 rifles."

73.speaker: Lucita Azaro
73.text: "But if we invested more into research, development and production in this city, our small arms industry could become a real force to be reckoned with."

74.speaker: Lucita Azaro
74.text: "Our navy has actually made significant strides in the past 30 years."

75.speaker: Lucita Azaro
75.text: "We are a coastal nation, after all, and our fleet is both well-trained and up to date."

76.speaker: Lucita Azaro
76.text: "Our submarines could use improvement, though. Compared to those currently coming out of Rumburg and Valgsland, they're practically ancient."

77.speaker: Lucita Azaro
77.text: "Our ranks are looking healthy already, Your Majesty. But since you asked..."

78.speaker: Lucita Azaro
78.text: "As you know, our central royal army is fed both by general conscription and levies from the individual provinces."

79.speaker: Lucita Azaro
79.text: "If you ask me, the provincial armies should be pulling more weight. Though I do understand that those of Brenas and Valenqiris are not nearly as well trained as Cardesse-Montaklar's."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "I don't see the need for that. It seems easier and cheaper to continue importing from Rumburg."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "Do we have the capability to build larger weapons too?"

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "I imagine that would give a boost to the local economy as well."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "We've got to take our diplomatic stance into account. Wouldn't a sudden increase in arms production be seen as provocation by our neighbors?"

84.speaker: Elena Werner
84.text: "It would, Your Majesty. As long as there were enough people available to fill the new positions that would be created."

85.speaker: Lucita Azaro
85.text: "Not currently, Your Majesty. Even if we were able to begin production in that sector immediately, it would take years before our missile technology caught up to, say, Derdia's."

86.speaker: Lucita Azaro
86.text: "Producing our own weapons would save us untold amounts in the long run. We could even ask Rumburg for a license to make our own KA-74s."

87.speaker: Lucita Azaro
87.text: "On the other hand, larger arms such as missiles are best purchased from Rumburg. Or barring that, Derdia."

88.speaker: Lucita Azaro
88.text: "We would unfortunately still have to rely on Rumburg for weaponry such as missiles. Although I've also seen promising developments in Derdia."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "Hmm. A weapons deal with Derdia could help improve relations between our countries."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "We shouldn't bother with Derdia. I'm counting on a stable trade relationship with Rumburg."

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "I doubt Derdia will sell us weapons considering our religious differences."

92.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
92.text: "It would depend on what they'd demand in return, Your Majesty."

93.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
93.text: "Yes, I'm afraid any negotiation with Derdia would be more trouble than it's worth."

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "This is ridiculous. What would we need missiles for?"

95.speaker: Lucita Azaro
95.text: "The wars to come will not be fought with guns alone, Your Majesty. We all know that."

96.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
96.text: "Everyone has a price, Your Majesty. It would depend on what Rizia is willing to pay."

97.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
97.text: "But I've set aside time to discuss Derdia during our upcoming foreign policy meeting."

98.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
98.text: "I personally believe attempting to sign an arms deal with Derdia would be more trouble than it's worth."

99.speaker: Lucita Azaro
99.text: "On the contrary, Your Majesty, it might serve as a deterrent. A nation that invests in producing high-quality weaponry is not one that you want to provoke."

100.speaker: Elena Werner
100.text: "Actually, were our foundries in Folce Dator to become productive enough, we could use rifles as yet another trade resource."

101.speaker: Lucita Azaro
101.text: "I suggest we think about procuring larger weapons as well. Derdian missiles, for example."

102.speaker: Lucita Azaro
102.text: "I look forward to that conversation, Mr. Esquibel. Where were we, Your Majesty?"

103.speaker: Lucita Azaro
103.text: "Our air force, meanwhile, is still suffering the consequences of the Pales campaign."

107.speaker: Narrator
107.text: Hugo wore a disproving look on his face. Across from me, Sal was smiling beatifically.

108.speaker: Player_Romus
108.text: "I don't need a ceremony to validate my God-given right to rule."

109.speaker: Player_Romus
109.text: "My apologies once again, Grand Wiseman Ignacius. I did not mean to disrespect the Wruhecist faith."

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "I made the right decision. Arcane religious rituals have no place in modern politics."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "I had my reasons for not participating in the ceremony. I don't want any of you questioning them."

112.speaker: Hugo Toras
112.text: "Whatever your personal feelings about the ceremony, Your Majesty, Rizia is a Wruhecist country. Breaking such a centuries-old tradition will have repercussions."

113.speaker: Sal Ignacius
113.text: "These rituals connect us to our past. A good leader draws not only on God for guidance, but on those who came before him."

114.speaker: Sal Ignacius
114.text: "Do not chastise your nephew too harshly, Your Grace. King Romus must find the divine path on his own."

115.speaker: Sal Ignacius
115.text: "Do not fear, Your Majesty. The divine path is yours to find on your own. Nobody can force you onto it."

116.speaker: Hugo Toras
116.text: "Still, Rizia is a Wruhecist country. It might have been wise to participate if only for the public's approval."

117.speaker: Hugo Toras
117.text: "The public will not approve of your decision, Your Majesty. But perhaps it will command respect among certain international factions."

118.speaker: Sal Ignacius
118.text: "Quite right. A man's faith is a personal matter. The King must be allowed to find his path on his own."

121.speaker: Hugo Toras
121.text: "At any rate... what's been done is done."

122.speaker: Hugo Toras
122.text: "Thank you for your reminder, Grand Wiseman. I am sure he will."

123.speaker: Lucita Azaro
123.text: "Less so, Your Majesty. Our police forces have kept a firm handle on our populace since the uprising."

124.speaker: Lucita Azaro
124.text: "Civil disobedience in Valenqiris, for example, is at a historic low thanks to your zero-tolerance policies as Duke. Not that it's ever been high in the era of House Toras."

128.speaker: Lucita Azaro
128.text: "Civil disobedience in Montaklar, for example, is at a historic low thanks to my zero-tolerance policies as Duchess."

129.speaker: Lucita Azaro
129.text: "My own anti-crime efforts in Montaklar appear to be paying off as well."

131.speaker: Lucita Azaro
131.text: "No, indeed. Iza has been experiencing periods of unrest ever since the handover of Zille and the exile of Duchess Angelica."

132.speaker: Lucita Azaro
132.text: "Valenqiris, too, is unlikely to pose major difficulties as long as House Toras is on the throne."

133.speaker: Lucita Azaro
133.text: "The members of House Sazon who rule Brenas have mostly fallen in line following the uprising. They're content to use the House of Delegates as a forum for their grievances."

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "It's no surprise that giving part of Brenas to House Toras would divide the region."

135.speaker: Player_Romus
135.text: "Let me guess. The Wehzek and Derdian newcomers have been causing problems."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "I knew it. The city was always a stronghold for anti-monarchists."

137.speaker: Lucita Azaro
137.text: "Well... ruling the Brenas capital after its transfer to House Toras would not be an easy task for anyone."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "What? Is my cousin failing in his duties as Duke?"

139.speaker: Lucita Azaro
139.text: "And the Central Police, headquartered in Rizia Imperii, have been keeping the capital secure."

140.speaker: Lucita Azaro
140.text: "We are not seeing anti-monarchist activity in Iza, Your Majesty. At least on the surface."

142.speaker: Lucita Azaro
142.text: "Complicating matters are the large numbers of Wehzek migrants who settled in the city following the Civil War."

144.speaker: Lucita Azaro
144.text: "If there's a problem area, it's Iza."

145.speaker: Lucita Azaro
145.text: "But we are seeing complications having to do with the Wehzek migrants who settled in the city after the Civil War."

146.speaker: Lucita Azaro
146.text: "Large numbers of migrants, particularly Wehzeks fleeing the civil war, settled in the city in the '30s."

147.speaker: Lucita Azaro
147.text: "As I mentioned in our earlier meeting, some turned to the black market to supplement their meager 'guest worker' income, giving rise to organized crime."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "We can't blame them. They had no other choice."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "Hugo, you were in Iza during the '30s. Didn't you try and stop this?"

151.speaker: Lucita Azaro
151.text: "The drug trade, mostly. There are cartels connected to families in Wehlen, who in turn answer to powerful distributors in Agard."

152.speaker: Hugo Toras
152.text: "We gave them a home and employment, Your Majesty. They chose to abuse our hospitality."

153.speaker: Hugo Toras
153.text: "I implemented a community policing program. But the criminal networks were too strong."

155.speaker: Lucita Azaro
155.text: "In my opinion, the growing influence of the nationalist group Su Omina has only inflamed tensions in the area."

156.speaker: Hugo Toras
156.text: "I attempted to tackle this myself with a community policing program. But the networks were too strong."

161.speaker: Lucita Azaro
161.text: "Certain members of House Toras may disagree, of course."

162.speaker: Player_Romus
162.text: "Indeed. A group like Su Omina is a necessary counter-correction to the problems caused by immigration."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "I believe Su Omina was founded with good intentions. But they may have made things worse without meaning to."

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "I agree completely. The provocations of people like my cousin will only stoke the flames of violence."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "Just because I supported the group in my younger days doesn't mean I do now."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "My cousin Rico has witnessed Iza's problems firsthand. If he supports Su Omina, it must be for a reason."

170.speaker: Hugo Toras
170.text: "The good Rizians of Iza are doing their best with the resources they've been given, Duchess. My son included."

171.speaker: Hugo Toras
171.text: "The problem as I see it lies in the lack of cooperation between the city's police force and those of the surrounding region."

172.speaker: Lucita Azaro
172.text: "Yes, I've received Duke Rico's complaints that the Brenas forces have not been providing him with as much aid as he wishes."

173.speaker: Lucita Azaro
173.text: "As well as his requests that extra police from our central forces be transferred to Iza and placed under his command. But I don't think that would solve anything."

174.speaker: Player_Romus
174.text: "And why not, Duchess Azaro? I thought you were tough on crime yourself."

175.speaker: Lucita Azaro
175.text: "I believe in the power of a firm hand, Your Majesty. But only when it's exercised with responsibility."

176.speaker: Player_Romus
176.text: "It would set a dangerous precedent. We can't have the other provinces demanding the same."

179.speaker: Lucita Azaro
179.text: "They are providing some assistance. But my instinct is that they, like most of House Sazon, disagree with Duke Rico's policies and his associations with Su Omina."

180.speaker: Hugo Toras
180.text: "Their political views should not matter. Their job is to protect and serve."

181.speaker: Hugo Toras
181.text: "Are you calling my son irresponsible, Duchess?"

182.speaker: Hugo Toras
182.text: "Iza is a special case. I'm sure everyone is aware of that."

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "You're right. Extra force won't solve anything. We need to get to the root of the matter."

184.speaker: Lucita Azaro
184.text: "Force is absolutely necessary in some circumstances. But it must be wielded with responsibility."

185.speaker: Lucita Azaro
185.text: "I am saying that in the wrong hands, the Central Police could legitimize Su Omina's campaign of oppression, rather than neutralize it."

186.speaker: Narrator
186.text: Hugo opened his mouth to respond. Lucita pretended not to notice.

187.speaker: Lucita Azaro
187.text: "Well, Your Majesty? Shall we continue with the briefing?"

188.speaker: Lucita Azaro
188.text: "I have the situation under control, Your Grace. You don't need to involve yourself with such a minor issue."

194.speaker: Player_Romus
194.text: "What about our intelligence capabilities? They're just as important as our military strength."

195.speaker: Lucita Azaro
195.text: "The Rizian Intelligence Service has operatives in Morella, Derdia, central Wehlen, Lespia and Rumburg."

198.speaker: Lucita Azaro
198.text: "He was afraid their leaders would get suspicious. He may have been right, or it may have been his trademark paranoia."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "I'm sure he had a good reason for doing so."

203.speaker: Lucita Azaro
203.text: "His Majesty Valero, however, insisted on withdrawing our presence from Zille and Pales."

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "That's ridiculous. We need to keep a close watch on both of those regions."

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "Good thinking. We cannot repair our ties with Wehlen and Pales if we don't trust each other."

209.speaker: Lucita Azaro
209.text: "Yes, my father told him the same thing. He was afraid of drawing their leaders' suspicions."

211.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
211.text: "What useful information were we receiving from either region before the operatives' withdrawal?"

212.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
212.text: "In my experience, we have much more to gain from straightforward diplomacy than from cloak-and-dagger operations."

213.speaker: Lucita Azaro
213.text: "Mr. Esquibel, if you think Wehlen and Pales are not spying on Rizia, you're fooling yourself."

214.speaker: Lucita Azaro
214.text: "We learned of the prior Duke Njolma's abdication before it was officially announced, for one."

215.speaker: Lucita Azaro
215.text: "He believed their leaders were starting to get suspicious of him. He may have been right, or it may have been his trademark paranoia."

216.speaker: Player_Romus
216.text: "That doesn't count as useful information. It would have come out anyway."

217.speaker: Player_Romus
217.text: "If the agents are gone, they're gone. What about domestic intelligence?"

218.speaker: Lucita Azaro
218.text: "But by the time it did, we had already determined our next steps."

219.speaker: Lucita Azaro
219.text: "Now that they have been withdrawn, it will be a difficult and costly process to get them back into place. But I can inquire into the possibility."

223.speaker: Lucita Azaro
223.text: "Domestically, our main intelligence focus has been on preventing another uprising."

224.speaker: Lucita Azaro
224.text: "To that end, our information gathering has been concentrated in Brenas, where the last anti-monarchist movement originated."

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "Can the agents in those regions be placed back in position?"

227.speaker: Player_Romus
227.text: "That makes sense. Can you put the operatives back?"

228.speaker: Player_Romus
228.text: "What about Valenqiris? I tried my best as Duke, but some traitors may have slipped through the cracks."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "What about Valenqiris? I didn't crack down on traitors as Duke, after all."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "On second thought, let's keep things as they are. We have other priorities."

231.speaker: Player_Romus
231.text: "We shouldn't be spying on our own citizens like that."

232.speaker: Lucita Azaro
232.text: "I'll update you should major concerns arise."

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "What about Cardesse-Montaklar? The military was involved in the last uprising as well."

234.speaker: Lucita Azaro
234.text: "As I've mentioned, the military has been purged and my province is now under the strictest of control."

235.speaker: Lucita Azaro
235.text: "History has taught us that if we turn a blind eye to potential traitors, we'll be the last to know when they come for our head."

236.speaker: Hugo Toras
236.text: "Rest assured that House Toras will not turn on itself. And it will most certainly not countenance being surveilled."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "Laurento is right. Let's not waste our resources spying on Zille and Pales."

255.speaker: Player_Romus
255.text: "Very good. Your house should be commended for its deep devotion to protecting this country."

256.speaker: Player_Romus
256.text: "You brought a weapon to a council meeting, Duchess?"

257.speaker: Player_Romus
257.text: "I trained at Camp Domus, too. You could've thrown that knife at me."

258.speaker: Lucita Azaro
258.text: "Another time. If your reflexes haven't gone soft."

259.speaker: Player_Romus
259.text: "Are you insane? You could've hurt someone!"

260.speaker: Lucita Azaro
260.text: "I wouldn't dream of leaving home without it."

261.speaker: Lucita Azaro
261.text: "Spoken like someone who hasn't gone through our training."

262.speaker: Player_Romus
262.text: "You made your point. No need to put on a show."

263.speaker: Lucita Azaro
263.text: "Sorry, Your Majesty. The spirit of Ana Azaro must've overtaken me."

264.speaker: Narrator
264.text: She grinned briefly before regaining her poise.

266.speaker: Lucita Azaro
266.text: "Of course, national security doesn't begin and end with the Rizian military. We also have our police and intelligence divisions to think about."

267.speaker: Lucita Azaro
267.text: "I was getting to that, Your Majesty."

272.speaker: Player_Romus
272.text: "You've given me a lot to think about. Let's call it a day for now."

275.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
275.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Intelligence"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_InternalSecurity"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Briefing_Military"] == true)) == false

276.speaker: Lucita Azaro
276.text: "Anyway. If we leave soon, we can make it back to Porte Drazon before it gets too late."

277.speaker: Narrator
277.text: She signalled to Titus, who tossed her knife back at her.

278.speaker: Narrator
278.text: In one fluid motion, she hiked up her gown, caught the projectile and stowed it in a leather holster strapped to her thigh.

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "I will remind you that this is a royal court, not a variety theater."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "Careful with that. I had a... bad dream involving stabbing."

285.speaker: Player_Romus
285.text: "Lower your hem, Duchess. The Lord frowns upon such indecency."

290.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
290.text: "We did not foresee that Lespia would become so heavily involved, nor that they would provide the Grand Duchy with cutting-edge aircraft."

291.speaker: Player_Romus
291.text: "Lespia wouldn't even have those planes if it weren't for their close ties with Arcasia."

292.speaker: Player_Romus
292.text: "So hypothetically speaking, if we tried to reconquer Pales again, they'd rain death on us from above."

293.speaker: Player_Romus
293.text: "I remember when our troops laid eyes on those planes for the first time. Their morale disappeared then and there."

297.speaker: Player_Romus
297.text: "We're better off strengthening our other divisions than trying to compete with the likes of Lespia."

298.speaker: Lucita Azaro
298.text: "My father always had terror in his eyes when he spoke of them. The silver falcons..."

299.speaker: Lucita Azaro
299.text: "We can't ignore the possibility of aerial combat. Many battles these days are decided above our heads."

300.speaker: Lucita Azaro
300.text: "Hypothetically... yes. We're more well balanced in the sea."

301.speaker: Lucita Azaro
301.text: "Very true. There is much to criticize about the West, but their technological prowess can't be argued with."

307.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
307.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_Conscription"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_NavyAir"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_Military_Weapons"] == true) == false

308.speaker: Narrator
308.text: The heavy wooden door to the hall creaked open. An aide rushed over to Laurento and whispered something in his ear.

309.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
309.text: "I see. I'll get to a telephone right away."

310.speaker: Narrator
310.text: He turned to the rest of us, his usual jocular expression overlaid with concern.

311.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
311.text: "I must excuse myself briefly, ladies and gentlemen. Please continue without me."

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "That's fine. None of these topics concern you, anyway."

315.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
315.text: "I will explain once I have all the details."

316.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
316.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I'll explain everything shortly."

317.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
317.text: "Our security and foreign policy are quite intertwined, Your Majesty. Nonetheless, I trust Duchess Azaro to provide you with all relevant details."

318.speaker: Narrator
318.text: He gave a quick bow, then rushed out of the room.

320.speaker: Lucita Azaro
320.text: "Hmm. I wonder what that could be about."

321.speaker: Lucita Azaro
321.text: "It was nothing. In my fitter days I could do it hands-free."

322.speaker: Lucita Azaro
322.text: "Danger can strike at any time, Your Majesty. Even here."

324.speaker: Sal Ignacius
324.text: "Indeed, modesty is one of the essential virtues of Wruhecism. For women or otherwise."

325.speaker: Narrator
325.text: The door swung open again and Laurento came back into the hall. He wiped his brow with a silk pocket square.

326.speaker: Elena Werner
326.text: "Well, Mr. Esquibel? I hope you've brought us good news."

327.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
327.text: "It's too early to tell if it's good or bad. But it's definitely impactful."

329.speaker: Player_Romus
329.text: "Preferably as soon as possible. We must decide on our official stance."

330.speaker: Player_Romus
330.text: "I don't see the urgency. We won't be expected to respond immediately."

331.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
331.text: "No, but it's good that we all get on the same page as a council."

332.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
332.text: "We are not expected to come out against or in favor of Lespia's alignment. But we should get on the same page as a council."

333.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
333.text: "I'll start preparing a briefing once we're back in the capital. We should all be on the same page regarding this."

337.speaker: Narrator
337.text: Lucita gave him a look of defiance as she readjusted her gown.

338.speaker: Lucita Azaro
338.text: "Pardon me, Grand Wiseman. It won't happen again."

340.speaker: Hugo Toras
340.text: "An early return to the capital would be my preference as well. But where is Mr. Esquibel?"

341.speaker: Lucita Azaro
341.text: "I'll inform our hosts that we'll be departing shortly."

342.speaker: Narrator
342.text: She pushed back her chair and briskly left the hall.

346.speaker: Narrator
346.text: I looked over at my daughter. Her brow was furrowed.

347.speaker: Narrator
347.text: I looked over at Hugo. His brow was furrowed.

348.speaker: Vina Toras
348.text: "The Arcasian Treaty Organization? What will that mean for us?"

350.speaker: Player_Romus
350.text: "Nothing for you to worry about, sweetheart."

351.speaker: Player_Romus
351.text: "I don't know. I suppose we'll find out."

352.speaker: Hugo Toras
352.text: "What do you make of the ATO development, Your Majesty?"

354.speaker: Player_Romus
354.text: "It's not good. I can tell you that much."

355.speaker: Player_Romus
355.text: "It seems like a lot of fuss over nothing."

361.speaker: Player_Romus
361.text: "It was fine. You know how it is."

365.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
365.text: "That is, after the lovely evening of musical entertainment that the King has so generously organized for us."

366.speaker: Hugo Toras
366.text: "Ah, yes. Albeni was an excellent choice, Your Majesty. Although I do hope the performance showcases his earlier work, not his more... chaotic contemporary offerings."

367.speaker: Player_Romus
367.text: "Those works are only chaotic to the untrained ear, Hugo. Listen to them for long enough, and a structure appears."

368.speaker: Player_Romus
368.text: "Same here. If I wanted to hear two hours of ear-splitting screeching, I'd pay a visit to my sister-in-law."

369.speaker: Player_Romus
369.text: "It's precisely that chaos that makes them so compelling. He's pushing the boundaries of music itself."

370.speaker: Player_Romus
370.text: "Music is a reflection of the times. Our era is far from neat and orderly; why should Albeni's compositions be?"

371.speaker: Narrator
371.text: Laurento reeled in shock. Lucita stifled a laugh.

373.speaker: Lucita Azaro
373.text: "I confess it all sounds old-fashioned to me. Have you heard the jazz that's coming out of Qinal these days?"

374.speaker: Hugo Toras
374.text: "I beg your pardon, Your Majesty. I'll be sure to listen more attentively during the concert."

375.speaker: Hugo Toras
375.text: "Boundaries exist for a reason, my nephew."

376.speaker: Hugo Toras
376.text: "But if you see the merit in his newer works, I will give them a chance."

378.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
378.text: "That's up for debate, Your Majesty. Should art portray the world as it is, or the world we want to see?"

380.speaker: Lucita Azaro
380.text: "But you have my house's gratitude for the gesture, Your Majesty."

381.speaker: Lucita Azaro
381.text: "I would also suggest extending the length of our conscription period, and lowering the conscription age from 24 back to 18."

382.speaker: Player_Romus
382.text: "Yes, why did my father even raise the age to 24, anyway?"

387.speaker: Player_Romus
387.text: "Hell, I joined the military at 18. It did me a world of good."

388.speaker: Player_Romus
388.text: "18 is too young. I myself wish I'd joined the military later in life."

393.speaker: Hugo Toras
393.text: "24 is the age by which a person's brain is fully formed, Your Majesty."

397.speaker: Vina Toras
397.text: "I do beg your pardon, Uncle Hugo."

398.speaker: Hugo Toras
398.text: "I mean no offense, Your Highness. But young people, especially young men, tend to make irrational decisions before that age."

399.speaker: Hugo Toras
399.text: "Young people, especially young men, tend to make irrational decisions before then."

400.speaker: Hugo Toras
400.text: "Indeed not, Your Highness. But young people, especially young men, tend to make irrational decisions around that age."

402.speaker: Hugo Toras
402.text: "I agree that young people, especially young men, tend to make irrational decisions before they reach their mid-twenties."

403.speaker: Hugo Toras
403.text: "You were unusually mature for your age, Your Majesty."

404.speaker: Hugo Toras
404.text: "But many young people, especially young men, tend to make irrational decisions before they reach their mid-twenties."

409.speaker: Player_Romus
409.text: "They get a little too trigger-happy, you mean."

410.speaker: Player_Romus
410.text: "No, I disagree. If you're old enough to vote, you're old enough to fight for your country."

411.speaker: Player_Romus
411.text: "That's simply not true. I feel my mind was at its sharpest as a young man."

414.speaker: Lucita Azaro
414.text: "As I've said, the 1920s were extraordinary circumstances. There will be no second mutiny."

415.speaker: Lucita Azaro
415.text: "You're sharp now, Your Majesty. But I will say that in war, the best decisions are not always the most rational ones."

426.speaker: Lucita Azaro
426.text: "We can achieve this thanks to my house. Camp Domus still runs the most rigorous, high-quality training program on the continent. Right, Captain Gordion?"

427.speaker: Lucita Azaro
427.text: "Ultimately, it's the readiness of our forces that will determine how well we can uphold our sovereignty and carry out our military strategies."

428.speaker: Lucita Azaro
428.text: "If our kingdom took anything away from Pales and the rebellion, it's that we learned the deadly cost of unpreparedness."

438.speaker: Lucita Azaro
438.text: "Focusing on the air force offers us a chance to establish aerial superiority, but it requires precise investments in procurement and fleet expansion."

439.speaker: Lucita Azaro
439.text: "Prioritizing the army means enhancing our ground capabilities with modern equipment and tactics. In my view, this will be worth every cent of the budget allocated for it."

440.speaker: Lucita Azaro
440.text: "Shifting our focus to the navy could significantly boost our maritime strength, but we must consider the costs of producing and integrating vessels."
440.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_MilitaryBranch_Airforce"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_MilitaryBranch_Army"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_MilitaryBranch_Navy"] == true)

441.speaker: Lucita Azaro
441.text: "Opting not to focus on any particular branch will allow us to allocate resources flexibly across various national priorities."
441.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_MilitaryBranch_Airforce"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_MilitaryBranch_Army"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Focus_MilitaryBranch_Navy"] == true) == false)

442.speaker: Player_Romus
442.text: "This is alarming. We need immediate measures to rectify this situation."

443.speaker: Player_Romus
443.text: "While modernizing the military is a significant challenge, we can't simply throw money at it. We need to be efficient."

444.speaker: Lucita Azaro
444.text: "But training is key. Each unit, from infantry to naval, requires preparation. We can't expect our men and women in uniform to go into battle with no experience."

445.speaker: Player_Romus
445.text: "Understanding the details will help us plan more effectively. Tell me more."

446.speaker: Lucita Azaro
446.text: "If you ask me, an immediate audit of our military assets is necessary. From there, we can fast-track procurement and training to address the most pressing deficiencies."

447.speaker: Lucita Azaro
447.text: "Efficiency is key. We must strategically allocate resources, perhaps starting with the most outdated sectors and gradually expanding our focus as funds allow."

448.speaker: Lucita Azaro
448.text: "We're facing shortages in critical areas like armored vehicles, advanced communication technology, and even basic infantry gear."

449.speaker: Lucita Azaro
449.text: "The strength of our Rizian Armed Forces lies in the diversity of our resources and units. We have manpower ready for duty,  as long as they're equipped with the necessary gear."

450.speaker: Lucita Azaro
450.text: "Now. A word about our military priorities."

451.speaker: Lucita Azaro
451.text: "Our troops must reflect Rizia's resilience, ensuring such blows never weaken us again."

452.speaker: Lucita Azaro
452.text: "We will also be training a paratrooper division under this initiative."

453.speaker: Lucita Azaro
453.text: "We will also be training an additional mountaineer division under this initiative."

454.speaker: Lucita Azaro
454.text: "We will also be training a marine division under this initiative."

458.speaker: Player_Romus
458.text: "Time to move on to other matters."

460.speaker: Lucita Azaro
460.text: "I myself joined the military while I was still in my teens. And I'm eternally thankful I did."

464.speaker: Lucita Azaro
464.text: "Which is why, Your Majesty, I'm very grateful to you for taking steps to address these inadequacies before the crown was even on your head."
464.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Focus_ArmedForces"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Focus_ArmedForces"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Overflowing"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_High"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_Massive"] == true))

465.speaker: Lucita Azaro
465.text: "But the way I see it, this is only the beginning."

466.speaker: Player_Romus
466.text: "I don't like what you're implying about King Valero the First. Attempts to slander my father's name will not be tolerated in this court."

468.speaker: Lucita Azaro
468.text: "I-- I beg your pardon. I only meant to say that I am looking forward to working with you on making improvements."

471.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
471.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Overflowing"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_High"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_Massive"] == true)

472.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
472.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Overflowing"] == true)  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_High"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_Massive"] == true)) == false

476.speaker: Lucita Azaro
476.text: "While our equipment stockpile has grown considerably, we're still facing a shortage of manpower. All the weapons in the world won't help us if there's nobody to wield them."
476.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Low"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_HalfFull"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_High"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_Massive"] == false)

480.speaker: Lucita Azaro
480.text: "While you've managed to rectify our equipment and manpower shortages in a surprisingly short amount of time, our troops still need training. A horde of well-equipped soldiers won't do us any good if they lack experience."
480.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Low"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_HalfFull"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_High"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_Massive"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_CombatExperience_Waning"] == true)

484.speaker: Lucita Azaro
484.text: "You've managed to rectify our equipment and manpower shortages in a surprisingly short amount of time. From here, we can focus on specialization and new technologies."
484.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Low"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_HalfFull"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_High"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_Massive"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_CombatExperience_Waning"] == true) == false)

500.speaker: Player_Romus
500.text: "How do the costs of training and equipping our units compare?"

501.speaker: Lucita Azaro
501.text: "The costs vary by unit. Obviously, the more complex the training and equipment, the more expensive it will be."

502.speaker: Player_Romus
502.text: "How long does it take to prepare a unit from basic training to full combat readiness?"

503.speaker: Lucita Azaro
503.text: "The majority of our units reach full readiness within a year, with specialized units requiring additional time for their rigorous preparations."

504.speaker: Player_Romus
504.text: "What's the point of keeping our troops in a constant state of readiness? It's not like war is on the horizon."

505.speaker: Lucita Azaro
505.text: "Not yet. But given the shifting allegiances all around us, we should be prepared for anything."

506.speaker: Lucita Azaro
506.text: "Besides which, the benefits of a strong, capable military go beyond the battlefield. The more power we project internationally, the more respect our neighbors and trading partners will have for us."

507.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
507.text: "Only up to a point, Duchess. We want our potential allies to see us as a friendly, open negotiator, not a bully."

518.speaker: Player_Romus
518.text: "I'm no master strategist. Are you expecting me to draw up plans for our troops?"

519.speaker: Player_Romus
519.text: "The entire armed forces of Rizia, under my sole command... I've been waiting my whole life for this."
519.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_Strategies"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_JoinedMilitary"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Focus_ArmedForces"] == false) == false)

520.speaker: Narrator
520.text: I saw a gleam in her eye.

522.speaker: Lucita Azaro
522.text: "You won't be alone. Together, we'll build a force as formidable as your rule."

525.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
525.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_Strategies"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_TrainingTime"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_TrainingCosts"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_WhyTrain"] == true

526.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
526.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_Strategies"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_TrainingTime"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_TrainingCosts"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_WhyTrain"] == true) == false

527.speaker: Player_Romus
527.text: "I appreciate all this information. I'll relay my instructions to you after this meeting ends."
527.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_Strategies"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_TrainingTime"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_TrainingCosts"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn01_MilitaryQs_WhyTrain"] == true

529.speaker: Lucita Azaro
529.text: "That's what I and our generals are here for. Leave the strategizing to us."

530.speaker: Lucita Azaro
530.text: "But don't hesitate to take the reins if need be. Sometimes, the intuition of a wise king can be more valuable than the by-the-book maneuvers of a seasoned veteran."

533.speaker: Player_Romus
533.text: "No need to say any more. If you all will excuse me, I'm going to get started at once."

535.speaker: Lucita Azaro
535.text: "You don't want to hear any more?"

536.speaker: Player_Romus
536.text: "Not right now. But I'm looking forward to many more private discussions with you in the future."

538.speaker: Player_Romus
538.text: "Actually, I do have a few questions related to military and security."

545.speaker: Player_Romus
545.text: "No, thanks. I have plenty of my own ideas for the military without House Azaro's input."

548.speaker: Lucita Azaro
548.text: "Very well. I won't keep you any longer."

549.speaker: Player_Romus
549.text: "I had a vision, Duchess. The Lord has shown me the way."

553.speaker: Narrator
553.text: Sal grinned triumphantly. A troubled frown crossed Lucita's face.
